review_notes: All six completed teams improved above three combined standard errors, but algorithm and budget changes were not isolated experimentally. The lower real-item-vector scorer is implemented; its global search-quality and speed advantage are not established by these gains.

Five runs stopped at 48 captured contexts before the 900-second search deadline. Chiori stopped at the 900-second deadline with 27 contexts. Flins stopped at 636.258 search seconds: more wall-clock time alone would not bypass its context cap.

Flins's best result is 141940.996 DPS, still 2792.528 below the known legal 144733.525 control with matching non-artifact inputs. Silken Moons Serenade on Ineffa was not captured in the 48-context run, so the first demonstrated loss is context discovery, before within-package item refinement and ordinary finalist verification. It is not evidence that the stronger build has been disproved by the simulator.

Current uncaptured-package priority evaluates raw item stats under the old captured context, without assigning hypothetical bonus damage. This removes false activation gains but cannot rank the full strength of a new bonus. Full queue retention plus wearer/shape fairness does not solve that information gap or certify the capped queue tail as weak.

Capture versus artifact-refinement seconds: Flins 395.52/219.06; Gaming 101.67/25.73; Navia 446.58/112.37; lunar bloom 535.09/79.96; bountiful core 380.42/32.29; Chiori 370.15/482.24. Capturing every package is costly; Chiori also demonstrates a substantial lower-search cost, so there is no single universal bottleneck.

Gaming's winning formula predicted 90834.442 DPS versus ordinary measurement 76331.804. The known two-seed reaction-schedule bias remains a separate model/selection risk. Improved measured DPS is not formula-response acceptance.

Next architecture proposal, not implemented or yet approved: reuse a shared reduced formula only for engine-derived, explicitly verified effect replacement; calculate actual inventory-plus-bonus bounds there, and require fresh scheduling/capture for dynamic or unproven effects. Selective capture must retain explicit unknowns. Discuss the activation/stacking/owner proof and bounded scheduling policy before another major implementation. Do not just increase 48 or introduce named-set favorites.

The matrix is stopped by user decision, not a new repair attempt. The installed full Go suite and 53 Python checks passed before the stop. Subsequently only the focused Go search tests (including formula-invisible ER through NewInventory) and five report/retention controls ran and passed, without simulator calls. No automatic matrix resume. Spread scratch (416247081 bytes) and the focused Go test cache (61923552 bytes) were removed; neither job remains.
